name: Compozy (CompozyOS)

runner.notes: Install CompozyOS beta (install.sh, npm @compozy/cli@beta, or pinned go install), start the local daemon, open or register the prepared runs/<run-id>/worktree as the workspace (session from that cwd), launch a session with an authenticated guest ACP CLI (e.g. Claude Code), provide prompt.md as the session task, then harness-verify on the worktree. Record Compozy version (beta tag), guest agent/provider, and interventions. Do not treat chat bridges or multi-peer network jobs as parity with a single local coding task.

inclusion: Direct Class A local-first agent operating system: Go daemon with durable sessions, tasks, loops, memory, permissions, automation, and Compozy Network around guest ACP coding CLIs (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, and others).
runtime_model_notes: Daemon/OS owns sessions and tasks; coding agents are ACP-compatible guest CLIs.
pricing_model: Open-source MIT; free local install. Bring-your-own guest agent CLI subscriptions and keys. Beta v0.3 line; no separate Compozy model plan on reviewed pages.
public_stack_signals: Official site brands CompozyOS as an operating system for AI agents: create, automate, and supervise agent work without assembling scripts/orchestration frameworks.
MIT Go monorepo at github.com/compozy/compozy; local-first daemon with SQLite-backed state; web UI, CLI, HTTP/SSE, UDS, MCP surfaces.
Runs ACP-compatible guest agent CLIs (README: Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes; org blurb also names Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor).

Core objects: sessions, tasks/autonomy kernel (claim/lease/heartbeat), loops, Markdown memory with dream consolidation, permissions/approvals, automation (cron/webhooks), Compozy Network peer protocol.
Install beta via verified install.sh (macOS/Linux), npm @compozy/cli@beta, or pinned go install; v0.3 is beta and breaks from deprecated v0.2.

research.positioning: A local-first open-source operating system for AI agent work: one Go daemon owns durable sessions, tasks, loops, memory, permissions, automation, and peer networking while running the ACP-compatible coding CLIs developers already use.

runtime: optional sandbox providers for isolated workspaces
backend: daemon-owned state (SQLite-backed stores per README local-first claims)
autonomy kernel task_runs with claim tokens and leases
bridge adapters for chat/forge platforms (built and installed from trusted checkout)
packaging: go install with pinned beta tag
data: daemon-local session, task, loop, and event state
unknowns: Full published provider matrix beyond README/homepage examples needs the live providers docs page checked at install time.
Windows support is not claimed on the beta installer path reviewed (macOS/Linux).
Git worktree isolation is not a primary product claim; workspace/sandbox semantics need hands-on notes for Class A parity with worktree-first peers.

infrastructure: Default path is a single local daemon on the operator machine with workspace roots resolved from the project directory.
Agent CLIs run as daemon-coordinated sessions; work and history are daemon-owned so closing a terminal does not erase state.
Remote access is explicit via Gateway configuration rather than a mandatory cloud account.
Automation and bridges can start sessions from external events while keeping the same local state model.
v0.3 beta is a breaking OS boundary versus the deprecated v0.2 line.

parity_risks: v0.3 beta APIs and UX may change between tags; pin and record version.
Guest agent/model quality dominates single-task correctness.
Not worktree-first by default; isolation model differs from Orca/Conductor-class peers.
Network, bridges, and long-running loops are out of scope for the current five-task local suite.
Ensure harness verify root matches the registered workspace / session cwd.

hypotheses: Owning the autonomy kernel and durable state is a deeper lock-in than a multi-pane terminal chrome.
ACP guest-CLI strategy rides model competition without reselling tokens.
Open MIT + local-first appeals to operators who reject cloud agent OS lock-in.
evidence: Official site and README define CompozyOS as a complete agent environment with daemon-owned loops/tasks/memory.
go.mod and LICENSE confirm Go implementation and MIT licensing.
PRODUCT.md states primary users are developers/technical operators running ACP CLIs through a local daemon.
unknowns: Head-to-head orchestration quality vs Hive/Fusion/Tachyon is unscored.
Stable v0.3 GA timing and long-term maintainer bandwidth are unknown.
Depth of each named guest provider integration needs install-time verification.
